title: The Home-Ground Puzzle: Why PCA Mohali Yields Parity for Punjab Kings
dek: Mohali produces {{ev:hg-rr-home}} runs per over and {{ev:hg-six-home}} sixes per match. Punjab Kings have won {{ev:hg-home-win}} at home and {{ev:hg-away-win}} elsewhere, demonstrating genuine venue parity.
excerpt: Mohali has been close to the average IPL venue. Punjab Kings home record against their away record shows no statistically clear home advantage.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: Punjab Kings record a {{ev:hg-home-win}} home win rate at PCA Mohali against {{ev:hg-away-win}} elsewhere, confirming neutral venue parity.
PBKS have won {{ev:hg-home-win}} at home and {{ev:hg-away-win}} elsewhere; the ninety-five per cent interval on the home figure is {{ev:hg-home-ci}}.
Toss winners at Mohali have chosen to bowl first {{ev:hg-toss-field}} of the time.

sections.heading: What Makes Mohali Different
body: Across {{ev:hg-home-matches}} matches in the CricField warehouse, Mohali has produced a run rate of {{ev:hg-rr-home}} against {{ev:hg-rr-other}} at other IPL venues, {{ev:hg-six-home}} sixes per match against {{ev:hg-six-other}}, and an average first-innings score of {{ev:hg-first-home}} against {{ev:hg-first-other}}.
Chasing sides have won {{ev:hg-chase-home}} of decided matches there, against {{ev:hg-chase-other}} elsewhere.

sections.heading: Does the Ground Favour the Home Side?
body: Punjab Kings have won {{ev:hg-home-win}} of their {{ev:hg-home-n}} decided matches at Mohali and {{ev:hg-away-win}} of matches elsewhere. The ninety-five per cent interval around the home figure is {{ev:hg-home-ci}}; a home record at least this far from even would arise by chance with probability {{ev:hg-home-p}}.
On this evidence there is no statistically clear home advantage for PBKS.

sections.heading: Turning Conditions Into an Edge
body: A distinctive ground only helps the home side if the squad is built for it in ways visitors cannot copy. Toss winners at Mohali have chosen to bowl first {{ev:hg-toss-field}} of the time, so the toss decision itself is rarely the edge.
The levers are squad composition and preparation: bowlers whose skills suit the surface and batters who know where the scoring areas are.

sections.heading: What a Home-Away Split Hides
body: Away records include neutral venues and seasons played away from home, and home records span eras with very different squads. A matched comparison would be fairer than this raw split.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Distinctive Is Not the Same as Decisive
body: Mohali has been close to the average venue, and the record shows no statistically clear home advantage for Punjab Kings.
A home edge has to be engineered through squad design rather than assumed.

seo.metaTitle: The Home-Ground Puzzle: Why PCA Mohali Yields Parity for PBKS
seo.metaDescription: Investigating Punjab Kings at PCA Mohali: 8.51 run rate, 71 matches evaluated, and why venue transitions have produced statistical parity.

methodology: Regulation innings only (super overs excluded); win rates use matches with a result. Generated from the CricField warehouse by scripts/editorial/engine. The home ground combines every venue name used for it in the source. The interval is a Wilson interval; the probability is a two-sided exact binomial test against 50%.
